summary: PR 7339 added GitHub Actions secrets and variables as the preferred source of extra Bicep end-to-end test parameters, keeping the CI Key Vault as a fallback. It merged after approval from jtracey93.
proposed: Let CI supply extra e2e test parameters from GitHub secrets and variables rather than only from the CI Key Vault.
changed: Names with a CI_ or CI__ prefix are matched case-insensitively to declared Bicep parameters, with precedence CI_ secret > CI__ secret > CI_ variable > CI__ variable > legacy Key Vault secret. Multiple aliases within the same winning prefix are rejected as ambiguous, and CI_KEY_VAULT_NAME is reserved for legacy vault config. The github-advanced-security bot raised CodeQL 'Excessive Secrets Exposure' alerts on toJSON(secrets) before approval.
shipped: The change merged touching .github/actions, .github/workflows, utilities/pipelines, utilities/tests and utilities/tools.
